messages:
emily-support: customer reported 400 from /v1/invoke when calling our payment-tool via toolcall in batch mode. schema validator: additionalProperties 'exchange_rate' not allowed. attaching payload and error.

emily-support: ```json
{
  \"request_id\": \"rk_1234\",
  \"tool\": \"payment-processor\",
  \"args\": [
    { \"merchant_id\": \"m_abc\", \"amount\": \"100.00\", \"currency\": \"USD\", \"exchange_rate\": 1.0 },
    { \"merchant_id\": \"m_def\", \"amount\": \"250\", \"currency\": \"EUR\" }
  ],
  \"mode\": \"batch\"
}
```

emily-support: error returned:

```
SchemaValidationError: data.args[0].additionalProperties contains forbidden key 'exchange_rate'.
Also data.args[0].amount is string but schema expects number; missing required field 'billing_profile' on the outer request.
```

alex-engineer: thanks — which SDK/version is the customer using? looks like client sent amounts as strings.

morgan-customer: @emily-support we are on sdk-js 3.1.0, sending raw amounts from frontend as strings to avoid float rounding. worked fine until yesterday.

sam-engineer: hmm, we merged strict func-schema enforcement in runtime-validators last week (deploy 2499123400) that treats additionalProperties as disallowed by default. previously we coerce string->number for amount in the compatibility shim.

olivia-ml: quick note: tool selection looks correct (payment-processor), not a wrong-tool routing issue.

alex-engineer: repro steps request: can you paste the curl hitting /v1/invoke (anonymize keys) so we can reproduce locally?

morgan-customer: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"request_id":"rk_1234","tool":"payment-processor","args":[{"merchant_id":"m_abc","amount":"100.00","currency":"USD","exchange_rate":1.0}],"mode":"batch"}'
```

sam-engineer: replicating now. on first run I get same SchemaValidationError. stack trace points to RuntimeValidator.check_args -> validate_additional_props.

deploy-bot: deployed runtime-validators@v2.8.0 to prod at 2499123400 (commit: 7b9f4c). change: stricter additionalProperties handling for func schemas.

qa-lead: can we add a targeted regression test for a shim that coerces numeric strings in args.amount and drops unknown keys when caller_id is in compatibility list? we should avoid global permissive behavior.

alex-engineer: plan: 1) short-term: add a per-customer compatibility shim that will coerce amount string->number and strip exchange_rate for m_abc (can be gate by customer_id) 2) mid-term: update SDK docs and publish patch for sdk-js to send amount as number 3) long-term: add validator hint to function schema ("allow_string_numbers": true) for explicitly allowed tools.

emily-support: implemented temp shim for m_abc and deployed to staging. customer reports calls now succeed. will roll to prod after signoff.

morgan-customer: confirmed, staging calls pass for us. thanks for the quick turnaround.

sam-engineer: filing follow-up ENGR ticket to add explicit schema options and regression tests: ENG-5529. also adding an opt-in compatibility list to support team settings.

emily-support: closing slack thread once prod roll is live and docs PR is opened.

alex-engineer: noted. adding a note to the release changelog about stricter schema enforcement and compatibility guidance.
